moves.name: Triple Arrows Barrage
moves.description:
Activation Condition:
When your team’s sync pair uses a sync move [Digit:1digit Idx="2" ] [EN:Qty Ref="2" S="time" P="times" ].
Deactivation Condition:
When this move is used.

Except in certain circumstances, successful hits with this attack become critical hits. Lowers the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ]. Makes the target flinch. The power and chance of applying additional effects of this move are not lowered even if there are multiple targets.
